evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies internal cryptographic primitives (HMAC and HKDF implementations).
rationale: Optimizes repeated HKDF expansions per RFC 2104 and hardens the output buffer interface against buffer overruns. The PR demonstrates a 20.6% throughput improvement in a BIP324 HKDF benchmark by caching inner and outer HMAC states, and replaces a decaying pointer with fixed-size spans to catch undersized buffers at compile time.
